```plato

    // The spacing a perfect hexagonal packing of `count` points would have over
    // the region: the yardstick the two readings below divide by, so that they
    // compare across counts and across regions.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Circle_packing
    ReferenceSpacing(region: Bounds2D, count: Integer): Number
        => count <= 0 ? 0.0 : (2.0 * RegionArea(region) / (count.ToNumber * Number.SqrtThree)).Sqrt;
```
